rotor_isotopologues.name: SO2F2 v=0
rotor_isotopologues.source: Search-engine excerpt of Sarka+ 2000 as cited by later work: A = 5134, B = 5075, C = 5057 MHz (rounded to 1 MHz in the excerpt). Near-prolate (kappa ~ -0.53) with the C2 axis = a: a-type spectrum, mu_a = 1.110 D.  Quartic constants exist (six, published) but could not be read: unknown here, and at J ~ 25 the unmodelled distortion is ~100 MHz, which the error model states.
